source_note: Pokemon ZA field geometry with decoded UV-mapped source albedo and PBR detail, presented with Pokemon Fracture/Revolt hopeful civic-adventure lighting and semantic fallback materials where a source map is absent. Exact 4 m project route tiles use decoded Pokemon ZA grass/soil maps. Exact 2 m city cobble and grass/dirt tiles use shared UV-mapped PBR resources and are explicitly separated from complete source-authored map sections.
runtime_pack_note: All 147 GLBs contain embedded image data. Godot's Extract Textures import mode materializes 1,831 equivalent companion PNGs beside the models; keep those PNGs and their import metadata with this directory. Ten additional shared textures serve the six route scenes and six grass/dirt scenes. The eleven directly placeable 2 m ground wrappers reuse the canonical ground_tile resources in this environment pack.
dimensions_note: GLB dimensions are source-space bounds and use runtime_import_scale at runtime. Authored scene dimensions are already runtime dimensions.
